title: Props: how parents talk to children

slides.say: Props are how a parent component passes information to a child. Think of them as knobs you can turn.
Step one. The parent passes props like attributes. Here, a person object and a size.

slides.text: Step 2: read them from one object.
slides.say: Step two. The child receives them. A component function takes a single argument: the props object.

slides.text: Props are the only argument to your component, just like function arguments.
slides.say: Props play the same role as function arguments. In fact, they are the only argument your component gets.

slides.text: Change the props in the parent without thinking about how the child uses them.
slides.say: Takeaway: props let you think about parent and child separately. Tweak the knobs in the parent, change the logic in the child.
